title: Fort Worth data center property tax abatement and Texas sales tax qualification
scope: Terms of one signed city agreement, county reporting by taxing unit, and separate state certification rules. The actual city credit for the expansion and its state certification require separate records.

city.title: Fort Worth City Secretary Contract 52160, Winner LLC 2019 expansion tax abatement

county.title: Tarrant County active tax abatements as of February 12, 2026

state.title: Texas Tax Code Chapter 151, Sections 151.359 and 151.3595

form.title: Texas Comptroller Form 01-929, qualification and purchaser proof by section

city_agreement.reduced_rate_trigger: Failure to meet the certified minority- or woman-owned business construction spending commitment
city_agreement.commitment_adjustment: The contract allows specified reductions for overperformance on the paired commitment with written approval.
city_agreement.completion_evidence: Temporary or permanent occupancy certificate for at least 100,000 sq ft and City Certificate of Completion for the investment commitments.
city_agreement.recapture_example: Section 7.11 describes recovery of abated city taxes upon termination for failing to obtain the Certificate of Completion.

county_report.scope_of_actual: The county table says the appraisal district combined the Winner LLC accounts. It reports cumulative amounts at the combined level.

state_programs.sales_tax_scope: Qualifying state sales and use tax
Qualifying state and local sales and use tax per Form 01-929

interpretation: Use the signed agreement and scope of the tax account to estimate any local tax effect. Use the applicable statute, facility certification and purchaser certificate for qualifying purchases. Listed requirements are selected eligibility checks.
